QuestInfo.name: [Goblin Night Market] Zzoblin's Dream Emporium Guide
QuestInfo.0:
#e#b<Zzoblin's Dream Emporium>#k#n

A #rDream Pillow#k is a special pillow that can be found at Zzoblin's Dream Emporium. The pillow collects dreams while you are sleeping, and you can trade those dreams to Zzoblin for #bEXP#k.

Rent a #rDream Pillow#k from Zzoblin at the Goblin Night Market, and it will begin collecting your dreams. Whenever the pillow gets full, return it to Zzoblin to exchange them for #bEXP#k!

#bEvent Period#k
03/25/2020 12:00 AM - 
04/21/2020 11:59 PM UTC
